title: The future site of Luke Skywalker’s Jedi Temple
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: On the lush planet of Ossus, Luke Skywalker trains Grogu in the ways of the Jedi. Grogu is quick to learn, though Luke suspects he's remembering things more than learning. That doesn't mean Luke doesn't have knowledge to impart, though, and they discover the ways of the Force together.
